    Proposition 4.1: retractions for the quotient construction #

    For F₁(T) = (Λe_y ⊗ W)/{s ⊗ a(v) + t ⊗ b(v)} (Construction 3.3), a homomorphism f : F₁(T) → F₁(U) induces h : W → W' on the tops, and the map d(w₁, w₂) = s w₁ + t w₂ with kernel {(a(v), b(v))} (3.1) gives the unique g : V → V' with ha = a'g, hb = b'g. Then ρ(f) = (g, h) are retractions for F₁ on D_fin; ρ(f) = 0 exactly when f maps into J F₁(U), so any n such maps compose to zero if J^n = 0. The argument does not use finite dimension; we state it on D_fin, where it is applied.
